title: Quarry-backed page utilities: find, zoom, print-to-PDF, full-page and area screenshot, viewport emulation, colour scheme
summary: Expose what the Chromiumoxide driver already does (full-page screenshot and PDF) through the gateway and the shell, and add the missing pieces in Quarry: a find action that returns match rects to highlight in the frame, viewport_set and reset through device-metrics emulation, a colorScheme session option that follows the user's theme, and a zoom scale. Frontend adds a find bar, zoom control, device presets, area-select capture and copy-to-clipboard. Print and screenshot outputs are artifacts, withheld under ZDR.
whyItMatters: Find, zoom, print and capture are table-stakes for a browser panel, and viewport control is one of the plan's own never-closed capabilities. Most of the capture work is already in the driver, so the gap is exposure rather than engine work.

referenceBestPractice.bestSource: Codex in-app browser (find, per-tab zoom, device metrics override, emulated colour scheme); Aside for the screenshot overlay with area handles
others: Aside (viewport and full-page capture, copy to clipboard)
Codex screenshots attached to comments and cropped thumbnails
referenceBestPractice.prevalence: Utilities: 2 of 3 sources, table-stakes. Screenshots: 2 of 3, table-stakes. Viewport emulation: 1 of 3 and colour scheme: 1 of 3, both unique.
referenceBestPractice.mechanism: findInPage open, query, next, previous and close; zoom percent persisted per tab with a banner; Emulation.setDeviceMetricsOverride {width, height, deviceScaleFactor, mobile} with an explicit reset; Emulation.setEmulatedMedia for prefers-color-scheme re-synced on theme change; full-page capture through captureBeyondViewport or scroll-and-stitch with a drag-area overlay. For Verevon: Quarry CDP calls plus a thin UI.

verevon.constraints: The shared chromiumoxide driver keeps one Chromium process with a process-wide active viewport: acquiring a lease whose viewport differs closes and relaunches the browser and clears every page, egress policy and dialog (chromiumoxide.rs:194-215). The gateway sends 1280x800 while Model Plane's quarry_agent.rs sends none, so a UI device preset applied through the lease would tear down concurrent runs; runtime viewport, zoom and colour-scheme control must be page or context scoped CDP emulation, never lease-viewport based. ZDR for screenshot and PDF artifacts is already enforced in Quarry and the gateway, so only the new UI must keep honouring the withheld state. Model proposes, Quarry executes: any new action (find, viewport_set, colour scheme) added to AgentAction is also a model-proposable action and needs a risk class (read-only for find, low for emulation); UI-only affordances such as zoom and find need not enter the model allowlist.
verevon.approachAdjustment: Reword into two steps. Step 1 (S, gateway and frontend only): add pdf to sanitize_action, add application/pdf with attachment disposition and nosniff to safe_browser_artifact_content_type, add full_page and a PDF button to the shell, and do area capture and copy-to-clipboard client-side from the returned PNG. Step 2 (M, Quarry): add page-scoped Emulation (setDeviceMetricsOverride with reset, setEmulatedMedia for prefers-color-scheme, page scale for zoom so the JPEG live frame stays sharp) and a find action returning match rects; do not route device presets through the lease viewport.
verevon.effortNote: Unchanged overall, but now two parts: Step 1 is S (exposure and one content-type fix); Step 2 is M because viewport emulation must avoid the process-wide relaunch behaviour.
verevon.verdictReason: Partial is correct and the item rightly says capture is already in the driver, but it omits two real gateway blockers for PDF (allowlist and media-type coercion) and it misses that viewport changes through the lease relaunch the shared Chromium, which changes the approach for presets. ZDR withholding for these artifacts already exists, so that part should not be listed as new work.
